messages:
maya: heads up — our premerge gate started failing after the latest scanner vendor release. lots of low-priority SAST hits with new rule IDs, so our suppressions no longer match.

ben: saw that. examples: old rule `AUTH_TIMEOUT_01` is now `AUTH_TA_2025`. suppression table lookup fails.

maya: impact: blocked merges, confused owners, noisy Slack pings. want a short triage plan.

tools-bot: summary: new-findings=27, likely-duplicates=19, severities={high:0, medium:2, low:25}. vendor: ScanCorp v5.2.

ben: short-term: flip affected rules to "monitor-only" in premerge for 48h so devs aren't blocked. evidence-bundle attached to vendor ticket.

qa: +1. also run a migration that creates candidate mappings by matching normalized message text + file path. i can validate mappings.

maya: long-term: add a fingerprinting step in the SARIF collector (message text normalized + file path + code context hash) so rule-id churn doesn't drop suppressions. also create a vendor-change runbook: validate mapping within 24h, publish mapping csv, update suppression table, notify owners.

sec-bot: created tracker SEC-2025-DS-9. recommended fields: timeline, mapping csv id, evidence bundle id, monitor-only toggles, owner list.

ben: i'll open infra PR to add monitor-only toggle + a small GH action to auto-label scans from new vendor versions. PR: infra#501.

maya: great. qa and ben will own mapping validation. sec will own runbook draft. will post updates in SEC-2025-DS-9.

tools-bot: evidence bundle EB-20251112-09 created and linked.

maya: quick policy note: moving forward, any suppression must include `owner@` and `expiry` metadata, otherwise it auto-expires in 30d. saves stale suppressions.

ben: noted. I'll notify the platform team and roll the monitor-only change now.

maya: thanks — keeping this low-severity but needs an owner to avoid repeat incidents.
